scene: Cradling your won plush cat, you exit onto the busy transit plaza.
picture: Side view along a glowing stone promenade. On the left stands the old man in blue cap and orange cardigan holding his cane and plush cat. Far left sits a waiting solar rickshaw. In the centre, a water taxi idles by a dock railing. Far right, a red funicular waits at its platform stairs.
shown: A yellow solar-canopied rickshaw with a friendly driver waiting on the far left
A teal water taxi idling at a wooden dock slip in the centre
A red glass-domed funicular railway car stopped on tracks on the far right
